event_model: Irregular evidence events and pressure episodes on wall-clock seconds. Regime labels exist only for harness scoring.

strategies.STICKY_EVER_DEPENDENCE: Enter protective mode on the first dependence event and never leave.
strategies.RAW_LAST_EVIDENCE: The latest evidence event directly selects cooperative or protective mode.
strategies.DECAY_HYSTERESIS_COOLDOWN: Exponentially decay confidence by wall-clock time, use separate enter/exit thresholds, and enforce a minimum protective hold.

nonclaims: The evidence values and timestamps are synthetic
The confidence half-life and thresholds are not host recommendations
The daemon modes do not control a live process
The harness-only regime labels are unavailable to the controller
No strategy is claimed globally optimal
